sources.label: BadFella Patches - community patches for Morphe Manager.
sources.author: BadFella
patch_list: Disables declared analytics and crash collection and removes advertising permissions. Keeps Firebase Messaging and location permissions. Does not guarantee zero tracking.
Restores Firebase certificate metadata on re-signed apps, with an Android 17 compatible token setup. Push delivery still requires device testing.
Restores task/reminder alarm scheduling on re-signed apps.
Enables client-side premium features and limits. Does not grant server-side AI access or a subscription.
